events.price_note: Festival passes and individual program tickets available
events.title: CROSSROADS 2026: SF Cinematheque x Gray Area Experimental Film Festival
events.why: 49 works of film, video and performance by 52 artists across 22 countries, with JG Thirlwell live-scoring Harry Smith's Heaven and Earth Magic — the benchmark venue's flagship experimental-cinema festival.

events.title: Oakland Art Murmur First Friday
events.why: Over 30 Oakland galleries open late with coordinated openings, plus a street festival on Telegraph with craft, art, and food vendors — the monthly Oakland art walk at its best.

events.title: Memories in Motion: Selected Stories of Mildred Howard — Screening and Q+A
events.why: Oakland art icon Mildred Howard in person for a film about her life and work, with Q+A alongside her grandson and co-director — a rare chance to hear a local legend directly.

events.title: Agentworld x Superdark Factory: Benjamin Bratton + Marek Poliks
events.why: Bratton's Antikythera think tank on planetary computation meets Poliks on fully-automated agentic systems — speculative technology and philosophy of intelligence at the Deliria2 benchmark venue.

events.title: Heart Trio: William Parker, Hamid Drake, Cooper-Moore
events.why: Three creative-music lifers with 30+ years of collaboration, collectively improvising on guembri, shakuhachi, hand-crafted ashimba, and frame drums — organic humanist music in deliberate opposition to technological acceleration.

events.title: Film Fridays: Standing Above the Clouds + Panel Discussion
events.why: Documentary on the Mauna Kea telescope protectors followed by a panel with the director and Native Hawaiian activists — intergenerational healing and cultural defense at a deep East Oakland community space.

events.title: Civic Center and Downtown Berkeley: Past, Present, and Future Walking Tour
events.why: A guided walk through Berkeley's civic center tracing historic buildings, the 2023 Civic Center Plan, and the evolving downtown — led by the Downtown Berkeley Association CEO and a local art historian.

events.title: SF Electronic Music Festival Night 1: Rrose, Idhaz & Emily Bouton, Blevin Blectum
events.why: The SFEMF 25th-anniversary opener: Rrose on The Lab's multichannel array, plus a violin/electronics duo and Blevin Blectum of Blectum from Blechdom — exactly the kind of strange signal worth following.

events.title: Tank Houses in Northwest Berkeley Walking Tour
events.why: Reconstructing a forgotten piece of circa-1900 Berkeley: windmill-topped water towers and tank houses that once stood on nearly every block, with five surviving sites visited on foot.
